overview.heading: A quiet courtyard motel in the middle of Mesa
paragraphs: Budget Suites Extended Stay is a single-story, Southwestern-style motel on South Country Club Drive in Mesa, Arizona. Each suite has its own exterior entrance with a teal door, a covered parking space out front, and a full-size refrigerator and microwave inside.
The suites surround a courtyard with a large grassy lawn, a shaded pergola, planters and seating — a rare patch of green in central Mesa and a comfortable place to sit out in the evening.
We welcome nightly guests as well as weekly and monthly extended stays. The office is open 24 hours, and downtown Mesa, Main Street and the Valley Metro light rail are a short trip north.

attractions.name: Downtown Mesa & Main Street
attractions.description: Restaurants, shops, public art and the Valley Metro light rail along Main Street, just north of the motel.

attractions.name: Arizona Museum of Natural History
attractions.description: Mesa's natural-history museum on North Macdonald, known for its dinosaur exhibits.

attractions.name: Pioneer Park
attractions.description: City park on Main Street in downtown Mesa with a large playground.

attractions.name: Mesa Arts Center
attractions.description: Downtown Mesa's performing- and visual-arts complex with theaters, galleries and studios.

attractions.name: i.d.e.a. Museum
attractions.description: Hands-on children's museum in downtown Mesa centered on art and imagination.

attractions.name: Golfland Sunsplash
attractions.description: Water park, miniature golf and arcade on Country Club Drive, south of the motel.

attractions.name: Sloan Park
attractions.description: Spring-training home of the Chicago Cubs, hosting Cactus League games each February and March.

attractions.name: Mesa Riverview
attractions.description: Open-air shopping and dining center next to Sloan Park and Riverview Park.

attractions.name: Usery Mountain Regional Park
attractions.description: Maricopa County park at the edge of the Tonto National Forest with hiking and mountain-biking trails, including the Wind Cave Trail.

attractions.name: Lost Dutchman State Park
attractions.description: State park at the base of the Superstition Mountains in Apache Junction, with trails and desert views.

attractions.name: Saguaro Lake
attractions.description: Reservoir on the Salt River in the Tonto National Forest, popular for boating, fishing and kayaking.

attractions.name: Arizona State University
attractions.description: ASU's Polytechnic campus is in Mesa; the main Tempe campus and Mill Avenue district are in neighboring Tempe.

attractions.name: Arizona Day Trips
attractions.description: The Apache Trail, Tonto National Forest and the Sonoran Desert are all within reach for a day on the road.
